name: sosfiltfilt
comment: DOC ONLY: numkit ships sosfiltfilt(sos, x) as a numerically-stable zero-phase SOS filter (matches scipy.signal.sosfiltfilt bit-identically). MATLAB exposes the same operation via filtfilt(sos, 1, x); their edge transient handling differs slightly from scipy's. Functionality verified in libs/signal/tests gtests.
